Definition: Indicator of any ICU day with daily TWA-PaCO2 <35 or >50 mmHg up to the landmark day
Cumulative number of ICU days with daily TWA-PaCO2 <35 or >50 mmHg up to the landmark day
Cumulative high-risk days divided by cumulative observable ICU days up to the landmark day
Cumulative sum of max(35 - TWA-PaCO2, 0) + max(TWA-PaCO2 - 50, 0) up to the landmark day, modeled per 10 mmHg-days
